During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] '''operation''' occurred over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Members of the [[Coruscant Aegis]] Squadron, supported by the Republic Navy, attempted to cripple the badly damaged [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] [[Overlord (warship)|''Overlord'']], which was defended by several ships of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Armada]].

==Background==
The [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Armada's]] [[Overlord (warship)|''Overlord'']], a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] commanded by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jocend]], led an illegal attack on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] border during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The ''Overlord'' was badly damaged during the attack, however, and was separated from most of its escorts. The ship attempted to hide from Republic forces in the upper atmosphere of the planet [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] with three [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]].<ref name="TOR" />

However, the Republic learned of the ship's location and sent a member of the [[Coruscant Aegis]] Squadron, supported by at least three [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]], to cripple the ship and capture Moff Jocend.<ref name="TOR" />

==The battle==
Upon arriving, the Republic forces immediately began to attack the ''Overlord'' and its escorts. The three Imperial escorts each attempted to intercept the Republic fleet and suffered heavy damage doing so. The squadron member continued towards the ''Overlord'', attacking [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Mark VI ''Supremacy''-class starfighters]] and the escorts while nearing the warship. The hero was tasked with damaging four shield generators and twelve [[Laser cannon/Legends|Laser cannons]] on the ''Overlord'', as well as eliminating 75 interceptors if the opportunity arose.<ref name="TOR" /> As the battle commenced three additional ''Terminus''-class destroyers came to the aid of ''Overlord'', one of which was destroyed directly after assisting. The battle ended minutes after beginning and the hero left Makem Te's atmosphere, a disabled Imperial warship orbiting the planet.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Makem Te Assault was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It appears as one of the first Space Combats available to Republic players, accessible after the player receives their ship and uses their holocomm to speak with Flight Commander [[Judin]]. In the Space Combat, players must destroy four of the ''Overlord''{{'s}} shield generators and then fourteen of the ship's sixteen turbolasers. The two-part daily mission "Operation: Noble Gambit" includes completing both Makem Te Assault and the Space Combat: "Archenar Interception".<ref name="TOR" />

There are also three bonus missions present in the battle. The first is taking out a total of 75 Mark VI interceptors or turrets on the defending ships, and another is destroying the Terminus class destroyer's engines (six in total) and shield generators. A third bonus mission, which can only be completed once a day, is to deal enough damage to the ''Overlord''{{'s}} bridge via [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] that the ship itself will be destroyed.<ref name="TOR" />
